dataset_release.name: KuaiRec-Official-v2.0
dataset_release.paper: KuaiRec: A Fully-Observed Dataset for Recommender Systems (Gao et al., 2022)
dataset_release.protocol: Train on Big Matrix (70% temporal split), Validation (15%), Test on Small Matrix (15%)

models.name: Exposure-Aware Popularity Baseline
models.description: Ranks items by training interaction volume and mean completion watch-ratio.

models.name: Item-Based Collaborative Filtering (Shrunk Cosine)
models.description: Item-item cosine similarity on positive watch-ratio vectors with neighbor shrinkage.

models.name: LightGCN Graph Collaborative Filtering
models.description: 3-layer LightGCN user-item bipartite embedding propagation with dot-product scoring.

models.name: Validation-Tuned Weighted Hybrid Ranker
models.description: Fused percentile ranks: alpha * CF + beta * LightGCN + gamma * Popularity.

reason_code_rules.description: Item cosine similarity >= 0.70 with an item in user's recent high-watch history.
Item ranks in top 15% of overall training completion volume.
Item has high collaborative neighborhood co-engagement from overlapping users.
Graph bipartite embedding dot product indicates high representation alignment.
User has < 2 recorded interactions in training; served via popularity fallback.
